description: Explicit field-by-field mapping of Prior's three persisted aggregates (candidates.Register, packages.Plan, campaign.State, with the structs they embed) onto the fusion JSON contract, as spec section 4.2 requires before any import. The rows are the contract as the Prior side ruled it at Prior c512c4c (docs/design/fusion-fj00-prior-mapping-ruling.json) against fusion 6667d63b; prior_review_commit is the Prior production baseline the ruling reviewed and fusion_review_commit the fusion snapshot it reviewed. Every row is confirmed: true, and confirmed=true approves this corrected target contract, not the unmodified Fusion implementation. The two candidates.Candidate rows Statement and Purpose stay after FJ04 (decision 260928-1420_*_where-do-a-candidates-statement-and-purpose-live-after-import.md, option 1: kept verbatim and frozen in provenance.legacy_fields beside the narrative). The on-disk shape is Go encoding/json without tags: keys are the Go field names; a nil slice or map is null and an empty one [] or {}; time.Time is RFC 3339; each aggregate's Revision is the hex SHA-256 of json.Marshal of the value with Revision cleared. Prior's modules/fusion/schemas/*.json are snake_case input contracts and are not this shape.

source_files.modules/fusion/candidates/register.go: lines 20-77: Source, Evidence, Candidate, Qualification, Disposition, Register, Predicate, Weight, Policy, Snapshot
source_files.modules/fusion/packages/packages.go: lines 19-56: Candidate, FormationPolicy, Package, Deferred, Attempt, Admission, Plan
source_files.modules/fusion/campaign/campaign.go: lines 21-53: Limits, Charter, Counters, Settlement, CompletionEvidence, State

conventions.key_naming: Go field name in UpperCamelCase becomes snake_case (StableKey -> stable_key, RefreshPolicy -> refresh_policy, WorkItemID -> work_item_id, CheckedAt -> checked_at).
conventions.fusion_path: <schema>:<JSON pointer>; [] marks an array of entries; a Go map becomes an array of keyed entries sorted by key on export, and key uniqueness beyond identical entries is checked by the validator, not by JSON Schema.

revision_encoding.prior-json-sha256: hex SHA-256 of Go json.Marshal output, imported as prior-json-sha256:<hex>
revision_encoding.prior-opaque: encoding unknown to fusion, imported as prior-opaque:<raw>

null_vs_empty.empty-string-refused: Prior requires a non-empty value; an empty one is schema-invalid at import
null_vs_empty.empty-string-to-null: Go empty string imports as null and exports back as empty string
null_vs_empty.empty-string-to-null-admission: an empty WorkItemID together with CurrentAttempt 0 imports as admission null
null_vs_empty.zero-to-null-admission: CurrentAttempt 0 together with an empty WorkItemID imports as admission null
null_vs_empty.zero-refused: Go zero value is refused (positive integer)
null_vs_empty.nil-refused: nil or empty slice refused where Prior requires at least one element
null_vs_empty.nil-and-empty-to-[]: Import maps nil and empty to []; provenance.legacy_fields.empty_collections records the originally non-nil empty paths. Export restores exact null versus [] or {}, including nested side inputs, before recomputing Go revisions. No normalization of existing Prior data.
null_vs_empty.nil-and-empty-to-no-records: No issue records for nil or empty Candidates; preserve the original null versus {} at register provenance so export can rebuild the exact map form even without issues.

conventions.import_stamps: Every imported record carries provenance.source imported, the raw aggregate revision as a prior_revision, and the removed or split original fields verbatim in provenance.legacy_fields; an import never invents a value, an unmapped field or unknown enum value is a typed refusal.

state_mapping.description: Proposed correspondence of packages.Package.State to a fusion.package/v1 status, from plan FJ00 step 6. The Package itself is always kept verbatim in campaign.formation.packages[]; these rows say which fusion package, if any, an importer would additionally create. Unknown values are never reduced to dropped.
